notes.title: Red Faction: Guerrilla 'Re-Mars-tered' edition set for release in July
notes.notes: "Space Asshole" is a song about a man who tries to get away from the pressures and travails of his life by signing up for a job working in the mines of Mars. He foresees quiet, solitude, and an opportunity to reflect on the past and contemplate the future, all while earning honest pay for honest work. But it all goes awry when a guy with a giant hammer charges onto the scene (in a truck), smashing and killing everything for no apparent reason except that he is, as the title denotes, a Space Asshole. The song was released in 2009 by Chris Remo as a tribute of sorts to Red Faction: Guerrilla, and now, in a tremendously fitting twist, it's been adopted by THQ Nordic for the Red Faction: Guerrilla Re-Mars-tered Edition launch date trailer. It's a remix, a little more rocking than the languid, defeated tone of the original, but still a great track—and a brilliant choice as promotional music. The remastered release of Red Faction: Guerrilla will feature "fully reworked graphics" and graphical effects, improved lighting and shadow rendering, updated shaders and post-processing, and native 4K support. The game itself sounds unchanged, however, with "open world guerrilla warfare" that enables players to fight where, when, and who they want, even if that means just running around on Mars bashing things into pieces, because you're not so much a revolutionary hero as a... well, you know. Pricing for Red Faction: Guerrilla Re-Mars-tered hasn't been announced, but owners of the original on Steam will be given the updated version for free.

notes.title: Steam Edition Update #10 Multiplayer Balance update
notes.notes:
Changelog
Disclaimer: All weapons and backpacks were restored to the original values from before all the patches and edited from there.

WEAPONS
  [Assault Rifle]End damage increased to 32 (from 29)
    Minimum threshold increased to 30 (from 0)
    Increased number of shots to go to maximum spread to 5 (from 4)
    Fine aim minimum spread reduced to 0.67 (from 0.7)
    Recoil kick reduced to 0.9 (from 1.1)
    Maximum ammo capacity increased to 160 (from 120)
  
  
  [EDF Pistol]
  
    End damage increased to 52 (from 48)
    Spread maximum reduced to 1.3 (from 1.5)
  
  
  [Sniper Rifle]
    Removed camera shake effect for enemies being shot
 
  [Grinder]
    Start & end damage reduced to 300 (from 350)
    Projectile speed increased to 54.5 (from 48)
    Removed camera shake effect for enemies being shot
    Magazine size reduced to 5 (from 7)
    Maximum ammo capacity reduced to 20 (from 28)
   
  [Rail Driver]
    Refire delay increased to 1050 (from 600) (Beam vanishing now matches the firerate)
    Magazine size reduced to 4 (from 6)
    Maximum ammo capacity reduced to 8 (from 12)
    
  [Rocket Launcher]
    Maximum ammo capacity reduced to 4 (from 6)
    Explosion radius increased to 3.65m (from 3.5m)
    Structural damage increased by 5% (23625 from 22500)

 
  [Peacekeeper]
    Start damage increased to 36 (from 35)
    End damage increased to 16 (from 12)
    Headshot multiplier reduced to 1.5 (from 2.5)
    Refire delay reduced to 292 (from 300) 
    Minimum threshold increased to 11 (from 0)
    Maximum spread reduced to 1.05 (from 1.2)
    Recoil kick reduced to 1.5 (from 1.8)
 
  [Shotgun]
    Headshot multiplier reduced to 1.4 (from 2.5)
    Minimum spread reduced to 0.2 (from 0.4)
    Maximum spread reduced to 0.4 (from 0.8)
    Maximum ammo capacity reduced to 24 (from 32)
  
  [Arc Welder]
    Damage increased to 33 (from 25)
    Removed camera shake and blur effects for enemies being shocked
    
  [Enforcer]
    Start damage increased to 33 (from 30)
    End damage increased to 24 (from 21)
    Minimum threshold increased to 15 (from 10)
    Autoaim reduced to 1.05 (from 2.5)


BACKPACKS
  
  [Firepower]
    Damage multiplier reduced to 1.25 (from 1.50)
  
  [Heal]
    Fuel usage per second increased to 0.85 (from 0.35)
    Health regeneration per second reduced to 400 (from 600)
    Health regeneration radius increased to 5.5 (from 4.5)
    Will now heal enemies within the radius
  
  [Rhino]
    Player hit damage reduced to 225 (from 350)
    Charge top speed reduced to 8.2 (from 8.5)


MATCHMAKING & CUSTOM GAMES
 
  [Playlists]
    Maximum player counts for Team Anarchy (8), Team Bagman (8), and Team Objective (10) restored 
    Minimum number of players to activate autostart restored
    Minimum number of players to start Large Mixer match restored to 8
    Removed the map Warlords from Anarchy (as it was previously)
    In Bagman when playing the map Haven you will now always be spawned with a jetpack equipped 
    Added the map Radial to Team Bagman
    Added the map Framework to Large Mixer for Team Anarchy
 
  [Settings]
    Restored default (1 minute) weapon respawn time to all modes
   
  [Maps]
    Restored previous alternative time of days for all maps except Doubletime and Downfall

notes.title: Steam Edition Update #6 21:9 resolution support, wallshot fix, FOV option for multiplayer and some balancing updates
notes.notes:
Changelog

31st October 2016
- Support for 21:9 resolutions
- Fixed bug, where player could shot through a wall while standing behind it.
- Added possibility to adjust FOV in multiplayer. Maximum multiplayer FOV value is 60.
- Reduced heal backpack "health regen per second" to 250 from 600
- Reduced firepower (commando) direct and area damage dealth factor to 1.2 from 1.5 
- Removed Arc welder darkness effect which makes it extremely hard to hit someone using it on you in combat
- Increased rail driver default refire delay to 1200 and MP override reload delay to 900. 
  This ends up matching perfectly so it's ready to fire when the beam vanishes. Making it easier to dodge and increases skill to use

Feedback is still always welcome. Thanks for all the reports so far.
Please discuss here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/20500/discussions/0/305510202680169194/
Cheers!

notes.title: Steam Edition Update #4 - FOV option added & Many Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello,

After extensive testing also thanks to our amazing community we are done with the next big update which features finally a field of view option for the single player mode among other fixes.

Changelog

9th March 2015
- Added option to change FOV for the single player game.
- Added console commands to show/hide HUD (hud_on/hud_off)
- Added support for QWERTZ keyboard layout
- Added player invulnerability when in joining in progress.
- Improved overall game stability
- Tweaked text chat color
- Fixed possible crash when leaving a Wrecking Crew game
- Fixed bug where text chat windows was not disappearing when leaving LAN game.
- Fixed Demolition mode/team chat 'y' key map conflict.
- Fixed bugs in Wrecking Crew - Free play mode.
- Fixed crash when the Reconstructor mod was previously installed
- Fixed bug where the Reconstructor unlock was always shown after finishing mission.


Please send us your feedback here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/20500/discussions/0/610574394236401923/

Enjoy

notes.title: Steam Edition Update #3 - Text Chat, Reconstructor in Single Player Mode and many fixes added
notes.notes:
Hello,

After extensive testing also thanks to our amazing community (http://steamcommunity.com/app/20500/discussions/0/619573787641750486/) we are done with the next big update which features text chat and reconstructor in single player mode as highlights among other fixes.

Changelog

20th January 2015
- Added text chat feature for multiplayer. Use "t" key for the regular chat and "y" for the team chat.
- Added the Reconstructor weapon for single player (main and bonus missions). It will be unlocked after finishing the game and then you can get it at the upgrade table.
- Fixed functionality of locking bagpacks and weapons in custom matches (it never worked on pc version before)
- Re-initiating matchmaking disabled when there is more than one player in the lobby.
- Improved overall game stability (thanks for dump files).


Feedback is still always welcome. Please discuss here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/20500/discussions/0/613948093870672354/

Cheers!
